unmapped_findings: The hot-rolled condition is used as the shared as-received reference state for all tested alloys in this study (Experimental procedure, b0026); the paper reports no dedicated micrograph or microstructural description of the 9Al-20Mn-1C hot-rolled sample itself.

In the 9Al-xMn-1C series, hot-rolled Vickers hardness decreases monotonically as Mn rises: 273 HV (9Al-10Mn-1C), 233 HV (9Al-20Mn-1C) and 216 HV (9Al-30Mn-1C) (Table 8). For the 9Al-20Mn-1C sample the hot-rolled reference hardness is therefore 233 HV.
